method: Direct NSF-converted MIDI inspection; note gates exclude unclosed note-ons. Pitch bends/controllers are counted but not applied to pitches. MIDI times are not WAV-synchronized. Converter tempo is not musical BPM; pitch totals do not establish a key. Missing MIDI uses existing audio timing evidence, not invented note analysis.
